verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's own annual-report page says it files annual reports for the customer automatically in all states as they come due. It integrates directly with secretary of state portals and shows due dates, filing status and approved documents, which matches a managed filing service. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the filing service, documented pricing or add-on packaging for annual report filing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on

citations.quote: We file annual reports automatically in all states as they come due.
Our software directly integrates with secretary of state databases and filing portals.
See due dates, filing status, approved documents, and more.
